SELECT PRO.* FROM ( SELECT fp.PROJECT_ID, fp.PROJECT_NAME, fp.APPROVAL_NUMBER, HBM.BP_NAME, HBM.BP_ID, fc.RATE_VALID_FROM, fc.LEASE_TERM, fe1.NAME host_NAME, fe2.NAME Co_organizer, FOU.UNIT_NAME, fp.PROJECT_ASSISTANT, fp.company_id, fqc.finance_amount, fp.EMPLOYEE_ID, fc.CONTRACT_ID, fc.CONTRACT_NUMBER, fc.CONTRACT_NAME, fqc.remain_amount, FP.CREATION_DATE, 'FCT_CONTRACT' CONTRACT_TYPE, (SELECT wm_concat(DISTINCT HBM.BP_NAME) FROM FCT_PROJECT_BP FPB JOIN HLS_BP_MASTER HBM ON FPB.BP_ID=HBM.BP_ID WHERE FPB.BP_ROLE_TYPE NOT IN('SELLER', 'BUYER') AND FPB.PROJECT_ID=FP.PROJECT_ID) GUARANTOR_NAME FROM FCT_PROJECT fp JOIN FCT_PROJECT_BP fpb ON fp.project_id = fpb.project_id JOIN HLS_BP_MASTER HBM ON HBM.BP_ID = fpb.BP_ID JOIN FCT_CONTRACT fc ON fp.PROJECT_ID = fc.PROJECT_ID JOIN ( SELECT cf.contract_id , SUM(case when cf.cf_item = 40 then nvl(cf.write_off_amount,0) else 0 end ) finance_amount, SUM(case when cf.cf_item = 54 then cf.due_amount-nvl(cf.write_off_amount,0) else 0 end) remain_amount FROM fct_quotation_cashflow cf GROUP BY cf.contract_id )fqc ON fqc.contract_id = fc.contract_id LEFT JOIN FND_EMPLOYEE fe1 ON fe1.EMPLOYEE_ID = fp.EMPLOYEE_ID LEFT JOIN FND_EMPLOYEE fe2 ON fe2.EMPLOYEE_ID = fp.PROJECT_ASSISTANT LEFT JOIN FND_ORG_UNIT FOU ON FOU.UNIT_ID = fp.UNIT_ID WHERE fp.DATA_CLASS= 'VIRTUAL_CON' AND fp.DATA_TYPE='NORMAL' AND fc.DATA_CLASS='NORMAL' AND ( fc.CONTRACT_STATUS = 'INCEPT' OR ( fc.contract_status='PENDING' AND ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM fct_contract ft WHERE ft.data_class='CHANGE_REQ' AND ft.contract_status='INCEPT' AND ft.ref_contract_id=fc.contract_id ) >0) ) AND fpb.credit_grantor_party='Y' AND FC.CONTRACT_ID NOT IN (select ppc.CONTRACT_ID from PLM_PLI_CONTRACT ppc where postloan_inspection_id = #{postloanInspectionId} and ppc.contract_type='FCT_CONTRACT')
UNION ALL
SELECT fp.PROJECT_ID, fp.PROJECT_NAME, fp.APPROVAL_NUMBER, HBM.BP_NAME, HBM.BP_ID, fc.LEASE_START_DATE, fc.LEASE_TERM, fe1.NAME host_NAME, fe2.NAME Co_organizer, FOU.UNIT_NAME, fp.PROJECT_ASSISTANT, fp.company_id, fqc.finance_amount, fp.EMPLOYEE_ID, fc.CONTRACT_ID, fc.CONTRACT_NUMBER, fc.CONTRACT_NAME, fqc.remain_amount, FP.CREATION_DATE, 'CON_CONTRACT' CONTRACT_TYPE, (SELECT wm_concat(DISTINCT HBM.BP_NAME) FROM PRJ_PROJECT_BP PPB JOIN HLS_BP_MASTER HBM ON PPB.BP_ID=HBM.BP_ID WHERE PPB.BP_TYPE NOT IN('TENANT', 'TENANT_SEC', 'VENDER') AND PPB.PROJECT_ID=FP.PROJECT_ID) GUARANTOR_NAME FROM PRJ_PROJECT fp JOIN CON_CONTRACT fc ON fp.PROJECT_ID = fc.PROJECT_ID JOIN HLS_BP_MASTER HBM ON HBM.BP_ID = fc.tenant_id JOIN ( SELECT cf.contract_id , SUM(case when cf.cf_item = 0 then nvl(cf.received_amount,0) else 0 end ) finance_amount, SUM(case when cf.cf_item = 1 then cf.principal-nvl(cf.received_principal,0) else 0 end) remain_amount FROM CON_CONTRACT_CASHFLOW cf GROUP BY cf.contract_id )fqc ON fqc.contract_id = fc.contract_id LEFT JOIN FND_EMPLOYEE fe1 ON fe1.EMPLOYEE_ID = fp.EMPLOYEE_ID LEFT JOIN FND_EMPLOYEE fe2 ON fe2.EMPLOYEE_ID = fp.PROJECT_ASSISTANT LEFT JOIN FND_ORG_UNIT FOU ON FOU.UNIT_ID = fp.UNIT_ID WHERE fp.DATA_CLASS= 'VIRTUAL_CON' AND fp.DATA_TYPE='NORMAL' AND fc.DATA_CLASS='NORMAL' AND ( fc.CONTRACT_STATUS = 'INCEPT' OR ( fc.contract_status='PENDING' AND ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM con_contract ft WHERE ft.data_class='CHANGE_REQ' AND ft.contract_status='INCEPT' AND ft.ref_contract_id=fc.contract_id ) >0) ) AND FC.CONTRACT_ID NOT IN (select ppc.CONTRACT_ID from PLM_PLI_CONTRACT ppc where postloan_inspection_id = #{postloanInspectionId} and ppc.contract_type='CON_CONTRACT') ) PRO
WHERE 1=1 AND PRO.BP_ID=#{bpId}
and PRO.contract_name like concat(concat('%',#{contractName}),'%')
and (PRO.approval_number like concat(concat('%',#{approvalNumber}),'%') or PRO.contract_number like concat(concat('%',#{approvalNumber}),'%'))
ORDER BY PRO.CREATION_DATE DESC

SELECT PRO.* FROM ( SELECT fp.FIVE_CLASSIFICATION_RESULT, (select s.MEANING value_name from sys_code_value_b_v s where s.code = 'PLM.FC_RESULT' and s.code_value = fp.FIVE_CLASSIFICATION_RESULT) FIVE_CLASSIFICATION_RESULT_N, fp.PROJECT_ID, fp.BUSINESS_TYPE, (select h.description from hls_business_type h where h.document_category='CONTRACT' and fp.BUSINESS_TYPE=h.BUSINESS_TYPE)business_type_n, fp.PROJECT_NAME, fp.APPROVAL_NUMBER, HBM.BP_NAME, HBM.BP_ID, -- fc.RATE_VALID_FROM, fc.LEASE_TERM, fe1.NAME host_NAME, fe2.NAME Co_organizer, FOU.UNIT_NAME, fp.PROJECT_ASSISTANT, fp.company_id, fqc.finance_amount, fp.EMPLOYEE_ID, fc.CONTRACT_ID, fc.CONTRACT_NUMBER, fc.CONTRACT_NAME, fqc.remain_amount, CASE WHEN fqc.fine_days <=30 THEN 'NORMAL' WHEN fqc.fine_days <=180 THEN 'ATTENTION' WHEN fqc.fine_days <=365 THEN 'SECONDARY' WHEN fqc.fine_days <=730 THEN 'SUSPICIOUS' ELSE 'LOSS' END suggested_classification, CASE WHEN fqc.fine_days <=30 THEN '正常' WHEN fqc.fine_days <=180 THEN '关注' WHEN fqc.fine_days <=365 THEN '次级' WHEN fqc.fine_days <=730 THEN '可疑' ELSE '损失' END suggested_classification_desc, 'FCT_CONTRACT' DOCUMENT_CATEGORY, FP.CREATION_DATE, FC.CREATED_BY FROM FCT_PROJECT fp JOIN FCT_PROJECT_BP fpb ON fp.project_id = fpb.project_id JOIN HLS_BP_MASTER HBM ON HBM.BP_ID = fpb.BP_ID JOIN FCT_CONTRACT fc ON fp.PROJECT_ID = fc.PROJECT_ID JOIN ( SELECT cf.contract_id , nvl(MAX(cf.fine_days),0) fine_days, SUM(case when cf.cf_item = 40 then nvl(cf.received_amount,0) else 0 end) finance_amount, SUM(case when cf.cf_item = 54 then (cf.due_amount-nvl(cf.write_off_amount,0)) else 0 end) remain_amount FROM fct_quotation_cashflow cf GROUP BY cf.contract_id )fqc ON fqc.contract_id = fc.contract_id LEFT JOIN FND_EMPLOYEE fe1 ON fe1.EMPLOYEE_ID = fp.EMPLOYEE_ID LEFT JOIN FND_EMPLOYEE fe2 ON fe2.EMPLOYEE_ID = fp.PROJECT_ASSISTANT LEFT JOIN FND_ORG_UNIT FOU ON FOU.UNIT_ID = fp.UNIT_ID WHERE fp.DATA_CLASS= 'VIRTUAL_CON' AND fp.DATA_TYPE='NORMAL' AND fc.DATA_CLASS='NORMAL' AND ( fc.CONTRACT_STATUS = 'INCEPT' OR ( fc.contract_status='PENDING' AND ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM fct_contract ft WHERE ft.data_class='CHANGE_REQ' AND ft.contract_status='INCEPT' AND ft.ref_contract_id=fc.contract_id ) >0) ) AND fpb.credit_grantor_party='Y'
UNION ALL
SELECT fp.FIVE_CLASSIFICATION_RESULT, (select s.MEANING value_name from sys_code_value_b_v s where s.code = 'PLM.FC_RESULT' and s.code_value = fp.FIVE_CLASSIFICATION_RESULT) FIVE_CLASSIFICATION_RESULT_N, fp.PROJECT_ID, fp.BUSINESS_TYPE, (select h.description from hls_business_type h where h.document_category='CONTRACT' and fp.BUSINESS_TYPE=h.BUSINESS_TYPE)business_type_n, fp.PROJECT_NAME, fp.APPROVAL_NUMBER, HBM.BP_NAME, HBM.BP_ID, -- fc.RATE_VALID_FROM, fc.LEASE_TERM, fe1.NAME host_NAME, fe2.NAME Co_organizer, FOU.UNIT_NAME, fp.PROJECT_ASSISTANT, fp.company_id, fqc.finance_amount, fp.EMPLOYEE_ID, fc.CONTRACT_ID, fc.CONTRACT_NUMBER, fc.CONTRACT_NAME, fqc.remain_amount, CASE WHEN fqc.fine_days <=30 THEN 'NORMAL' WHEN fqc.fine_days <=180 THEN 'ATTENTION' WHEN fqc.fine_days <=365 THEN 'SECONDARY' WHEN fqc.fine_days <=730 THEN 'SUSPICIOUS' ELSE 'LOSS' END suggested_classification, CASE WHEN fqc.fine_days <=30 THEN '正常' WHEN fqc.fine_days <=180 THEN '关注' WHEN fqc.fine_days <=365 THEN '次级' WHEN fqc.fine_days <=730 THEN '可疑' ELSE '损失' END suggested_classification_desc, 'CON_CONTRACT' DOCUMENT_CATEGORY, FP.CREATION_DATE, FC.CREATED_BY FROM PRJ_PROJECT fp JOIN CON_CONTRACT fc ON fp.PROJECT_ID = fc.PROJECT_ID JOIN HLS_BP_MASTER HBM ON HBM.BP_ID = fc.tenant_id JOIN ( SELECT cf.contract_id , nvl(MAX(cf.fine_days),0) fine_days, SUM( case when cf.cf_item=0 then nvl(cf.received_amount,0) else 0 end) finance_amount, SUM( case when cf.cf_item=1 then (cf.principal-nvl(cf.received_principal,0)) else 0 end) remain_amount FROM CON_CONTRACT_CASHFLOW cf GROUP BY cf.contract_id )fqc ON fqc.contract_id = fc.contract_id LEFT JOIN FND_EMPLOYEE fe1 ON fe1.EMPLOYEE_ID = fp.EMPLOYEE_ID LEFT JOIN FND_EMPLOYEE fe2 ON fe2.EMPLOYEE_ID = fp.PROJECT_ASSISTANT LEFT JOIN FND_ORG_UNIT FOU ON FOU.UNIT_ID = fp.UNIT_ID WHERE fp.DATA_CLASS= 'VIRTUAL_CON' AND fp.DATA_TYPE='NORMAL' AND fc.DATA_CLASS='NORMAL' AND ( fc.CONTRACT_STATUS = 'INCEPT' OR ( fc.contract_status='PENDING' AND ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM fct_contract ft WHERE ft.data_class='CHANGE_REQ' AND ft.contract_status='INCEPT' AND ft.ref_contract_id=fc.contract_id ) >0) ) ) PRO
WHERE 1=1
AND PRO.FIVE_CLASSIFICATION_RESULT like concat(concat('%',#{fiveClassificationResult}),'%')
AND (PRO.CONTRACT_NUMBER like concat(concat('%',#{contractNumber}),'%') OR PRO.BP_NAME like concat(concat('%',#{contractNumber}),'%') OR PRO.APPROVAL_NUMBER like concat(concat('%',#{contractNumber}),'%'))
AND PRO.FIVE_CLASSIFICATION_RESULT IN
#{item}
ORDER BY PRO.CREATION_DATE DESC

mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT CON.EMPLOYEE_ASSIGN_ID FROM ( SELECT PEA.EMPLOYEE_ASSIGN_ID, PPC.POSTLOAN_INSPECTION_ID FROM CON_CONTRACT CC JOIN FND_EMPLOYEE_ASSIGNS PEA ON CC.EMPLOYEE_ID=PEA.EMPLOYEE_ID JOIN PLM_PLI_CONTRACT PPC ON CC.CONTRACT_ID=PPC.CONTRACT_ID WHERE PPC.CONTRACT_TYPE='CON_CONTRACT' UNION SELECT FC.EMPLOYEE_ASSIGN_ID, PPC.POSTLOAN_INSPECTION_ID FROM FCT_CONTRACT FC JOIN PLM_PLI_CONTRACT PPC ON FC.CONTRACT_ID=PPC.CONTRACT_ID WHERE PPC.CONTRACT_TYPE='FCT_CONTRACT') CON WHERE CON.POSTLOAN_INSPECTION_ID= #{postloanInspectionId}

SELECT DISTINCT CON.UNIT_ID FROM ( SELECT cc.UNIT_ID, PPC.POSTLOAN_INSPECTION_ID FROM CON_CONTRACT CC JOIN PLM_PLI_CONTRACT PPC ON CC.CONTRACT_ID=PPC.CONTRACT_ID WHERE PPC.CONTRACT_TYPE='CON_CONTRACT' UNION SELECT FC.UNIT_ID, PPC.POSTLOAN_INSPECTION_ID FROM FCT_CONTRACT FC JOIN PLM_PLI_CONTRACT PPC ON FC.CONTRACT_ID=PPC.CONTRACT_ID WHERE PPC.CONTRACT_TYPE='FCT_CONTRACT') CON WHERE CON.POSTLOAN_INSPECTION_ID= #{postloanInspectionId}
